# GitHub operating assets

Version: 0.2 | Updated: 2026-09-09 | Status: Draft specification

The [pull request template](pull_request_template.md) supports reviewable work. [Issue templates](ISSUE_TEMPLATE/README.md) and [automation](workflows/README.md) describe pending implementation.

No active workflow YAML or branch protection is installed by this foundation. Add executable automation with the checks, credentials, and repository permissions it requires.
